actions.confirm_base: This replaces the walk or get-up policy. Go ahead?
actions.import_help: Pick the policy.onnx and manifest.json (Microduck schema 2). They are converted and checked in the browser. An imported policy runs from this page only until you try it in preview and mark it verified.
actions.one_policy: This lists a set of policies; pick the manifest.json of one policy
actions.try_help: Runs in preview with torque off; check that the joint targets below look smooth and sane (the servos do not move).
control.keys: Keys: W/S forward, A/D sideways, Q/E turn, Space stops
control.head: Head
control.no_skills: No skills yet: import some on Actions
control.voice_off_warn: Voice is off: neither the wake word nor "stop" is heard
err.bad_velocity: The velocity is not a number
err.battery_low: Battery low, charge it before turning torque on
err.calib_holding: Calibration is holding the servos; enter it without hold
err.calib_mismatch: The calibration is for another robot or is damaged
err.calib_needs_hold: Stand the duck in the default pose (hold) on flat ground first
err.exit_setup_first: Leave calibration or servo setup first
err.feedback_lost: Servo or IMU feedback lost, torque off
err.id_both_reply: Old and new id both answer; connect one servo only and scan again
err.id_new_no_reply: New id written, but it does not answer; scan again
err.id_no_reply: No servo answers this id; id not changed
err.in_setup: No motion during calibration or servo setup
err.level_needs_rest: Leveling needs torque off, or standing in the default pose on flat ground
err.no_base_policies: No walk or get-up policy; import them first
err.no_feedback: No feedback from the servos or the IMU
err.ota_package: Wrong upgrade package: its kind, contents or board do not match
err.ota_offset: The upload was interrupted; upload the package again
err.policy_action_scale: Action_scale other than 1 is not supported
err.policy_duration: The policy needs duration_s or command.period_s
err.policy_home: doitduck.home_deg needs one number per motor
err.policy_in_use: The policy is in use; turn torque off or let it finish
err.policy_kind: This kind and command encoding are not supported
err.policy_manifest: The manifest is missing or not valid JSON
err.policy_name: A policy name is letters, digits, _ and -, and unique
err.policy_not_finite: The policy output NaN or Inf, torque off
err.policy_not_verified: This policy is not verified yet; run it from the web page first
err.policy_replace_base: This replaces the walk or get-up policy; confirm it
err.policy_robot_model: The policy is for another robot (robot.model not in compatible_models)
err.policy_size: The weights are not a 61-512-256-128-14 network
err.setup_heartbeat_lost: Calibration or servo setup lost its heartbeat and was left
err.setup_web_only: Calibration and servo setup start from the web page only
err.skill_needs_walk: Skills run in walk or preview mode
err.skill_not_now: Skills run only while standing, with no other skill running
err.sound_format: A sound is a 16 kHz mono 16-bit WAV of at most 3 s
err.sound_name: A sound name is letters, digits, _ and -
err.sound_too_often: At most one sound a second from each source
err.web_only: This method is for the web page only
err.wifi_password: A password is 8 to 63 plain characters, or empty for an open network
err.wifi_ssid: A network name is 1 to 32 bytes
err.wifi_write: Could not save the network or start Wi-Fi
first.calibrate: The zeros are not calibrated: run the wizard on Maintain →
first.level: The torso is not leveled yet: step 4 of the wizard →
first.policies: No walk or get-up policy yet: import them on Actions →
maintain.confirm_undo: Go back to the calibration before?
maintain.data_help: Export the calibration to bring it back after reflashing or changing the main board. Undo goes back to before the last change.
maintain.servo_help: Scan the bus, read positions, change ids and gains. Relax first, then enter servo setup.
settings.licenses: This project: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0, no commercial use. Third party: jmuxer (MIT), cJSON (MIT), Mbed TLS (Apache-2.0). Policies and recognition models are downloaded by you, under their own licenses.
settings.ota_help: The app and the models are upgraded separately; make the packages with tools/pack_ota.sh. The package is installed and the program restarts; calibration, Wi-Fi, imported policies and other data are kept.
settings.ota_app: App (program, web page, robot config, sounds)
settings.ota_models: Models (only those of the same names are replaced, the others stay)
settings.ota_wrong: Not an upgrade package of this kind (no version.json, or another kind)
settings.smoothing_help: 0 is none; higher is softer but slower. A policy whose manifest sets its own uses that while it runs.
settings.upload_help: The same name as a built-in quack replaces it; a new name adds one. Converted to 16 kHz mono, at most 3 s.
settings.upload_need: Give a name and pick a file
settings.wifi_failed: Could not connect. Check the password
settings.wifi_help: Saying “开始配网” to the duck also opens the hotspot.
settings.wifi_none: No network found; scan again in a few seconds
settings.xz_help: First time: add the device at xiaozhi.me with the 6-digit code above.
status.tof_help: 8×8 zones in cm, near red and far blue, grey where nothing was measured. The sensor sees the scene mirrored.
status.tof_off: The sensor is not answering (restart to try again)
wizard.enter_help: All torque off: the joints move by hand
wizard.enter_hold_help: The servos hold where they are, with no sudden move
wizard.imu_failed: Not measured. Keep it still and try again
wizard.imu_help: With torque off and the duck still, measures the gyro bias (about 2 s).
wizard.level_failed: Not measured. Keep it still and try again
wizard.no_suggestion: No suggestion (calibration.roll_fix is empty); nudge by hand below
wizard.servos_help: Relax first. Checks that every servo and the IMU board answer on the bus.
wizard.stand_help: On flat ground press Stand. Measures the torso and each joint's tracking error and suggests nudges; then level the IMU.
wizard.zero_help: Pose the duck for calibration: legs straight, head forward (fit the jig if you have one). The table shows how far each joint is from its factory zero; far off may be a horn one tooth off or the pose not right. Pose them all and press Record all, or go one at a time: hold a joint and press Record on its row. The step is done once every joint is recorded.
wizard.zero_hold_help: The servos hold with a weak force (KP 3); support the duck. Drag the slider under each joint to turn it to its zero and press Record on its row: its present position becomes the zero. The step is done once every joint is recorded.
xzr.activate: Enter the activation code at xiaozhi.me
xzr.no_server: Cannot reach the server; waiting for the network
xzr.no_websocket: No conversation address from the server
